verses.en: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.pt: Porque eis que naqueles dias e naquele tempo eu restaurarei Judá e Jerusalém de seu infortúnio.
verses.en_web: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.en_bbe: For in those days and in that time, when I let the fate of Judah and Jerusalem be changed,

verses.en: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
verses.pt: Então ajuntarei todas as nações, e as farei descer ao vale de Josafá; e ali entrarei em juízo com elas por causa do meu povo, e de minha herança Israel, aos quais dispersaram entre as nações, e repartiram minha terra;
verses.en_web: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,
verses.en_bbe: I will get together all the nations, and make them come down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and there I will take up with them the cause of my people and of my heritage Israel, whom they have sent wandering among the nations, and of my land which has been parted by them.

verses.en: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
verses.pt: E lançaram sortes sobre meu povo, e deram os rapazes em troca de prostitutas, e venderam as moças em troca de vinho para beberem.
verses.en_web: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
verses.en_bbe: And they have put the fate of my people to the decision of chance: giving a boy for the price of a loose woman and a girl for a drink of wine.

verses.en: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
verses.pt: Além disso, o que tendes a ver comigo vós, Tiro e Sidom, e todas as regiões da Filístia? Quereis vos vingar de mim? E se quereis vos vingar de mim, apressadamente eu vos retribuirei o pagamento sobre vossa cabeça.
verses.en_web: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre, and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.
verses.en_bbe: And further, what are you to me, O Tyre and Zidon and all the circle of Philistia? will you give me back any payment? and if you do, quickly and suddenly I will send it back on your head,

verses.en: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
verses.pt: Pois levastes minha prata e meu ouro, e minhas coisas valiosas e boas pusestes em vossos templos,
verses.en_web: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,
verses.en_bbe: For you have taken my silver and my gold, putting in the houses of your gods my beautiful and pleasing things.

verses.en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
verses.pt: E vendestes os filhos de Judá e os filhos de Jerusalém aos filhos dos gregos, para os distanciar de sua pátria.
verses.en_web: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem you have given for a price to the sons of the Greeks, to send them far away from their land:

verses.en: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
verses.pt: Eis que eu os levantarei do lugar para onde os vendestes, e retribuirei vosso pagamento sobre vossa cabeça.
verses.en_web: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;
verses.en_bbe: See, I will have them moved from the place where you have sent them, and will let what you have done come back on your head;

verses.en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.pt: E venderei vossos filhos e vossas filhas na mão dos filhos de Judá, e eles os venderão aos sabeus, uma nação distante; porque o SENHOR falou.
verses.en_web: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
verses.en_bbe: I will give your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah for a price, and they will give them for a price to the men of Sheba, a nation far off: for the Lord has said it.

verses.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
verses.pt: Proclamai isto entre as nações, convocai uma guerra; despertai aos guerreiros, acheguem-se, venham todos os homens de guerra.
verses.en_web: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.
verses.en_bbe: Give this out among the nations; make ready for war: get the strong men awake; let all the men of war come near, let them come up.

verses.en: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verses.pt: Fazei espadas de vossas enxadas, e lanças de vossas foices; diga o fraco: Sou forte.
verses.en_web: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’
verses.en_bbe: Get your plough-blades hammered into swords, and your vine-knives into spears: let the feeble say, I am strong.

verses.en: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.
verses.pt: Ajuntai-vos e vinde, todas as nações ao redor, e reuni-vos. (Ó SENHOR, faze vir ali os teus fortes!)
verses.en_web: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Come quickly, all you nations round about, and get yourselves together there: make your strong ones come down, O Lord.

verses.en: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
verses.pt: Levantem-se as nações, e subam ao vale de Josafá; porque ali eu me sentarei para julgar todas as nações ao redor.
verses.en_web: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there will I sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
verses.en_bbe: Let the nations be awake, and come to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there I will be seated as judge of all the nations round about.

verses.en: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
verses.pt: Lançai a foice, porque a colheita já está madura. Vinde, descei; porque a prensa de uvas está cheia, os tanques transbordam; porque a maldade deles é grande.
verses.en_web: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”
verses.en_bbe: Put in the blade, for the grain is ready: come, get you down, for the wine-crusher is full, the vessels are overflowing; for great is their evil-doing.

verses.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
verses.pt: Multidões! Multidões no vale da decisão! Porque perto está o dia do SENHOR no vale da decisão.
verses.en_web: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of Yahweh is near, in the valley of decision.
verses.en_bbe: Masses on masses in the valley of decision! for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.

verses.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
verses.pt: O sol e a lua se escurecerão, e as estrelas recolherão seu brilho.
verses.en_web: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.en_bbe: The sun and the moon have become dark, and the stars keep back their shining.

verses.en: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR bramará desde Sião, e dará sua voz desde Jerusalém, e os céus e a terra tremerão; mas o SENHOR será o refúgio de seu povo, e a fortaleza dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but Yahweh will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord will be thundering from Zion, and his voice will be sounding from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will be shaking: but the Lord will be a breastplate for his people and a strong place for the children of Israel.

verses.en: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
verses.pt: Então sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que habito em Sião, o meu santo monte; e Jerusalém será santa, e estrangeiros não mais passarão mais por ela.
verses.en_web: “So you will know that I am Yahweh, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be certain that I am the Lord your God, living in Zion, my holy mountain: and Jerusalem will be holy, and no strange person will ever again go through her.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
verses.pt: E será naquele tempo, que os montes destilarão suco de uva, e os morros fluirão leite, e por todos os ribeiros de Judá correrão águas; e sairá uma fonte da casa do SENHOR, que regará o vale de Sitim.
verses.en_web: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters, and a fountain will flow out from Yahweh’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about in that day that the mountains will be dropping sweet wine, and the hills will be flowing with milk, and all the streams of Judah will be flowing with water; and a fountain will come out from the house of the Lord, watering the valley of acacia-trees.

verses.en: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.pt: O Egito será uma assolação, e Edom se tornará um deserto assolado, por causa da violência que fizeram aos filhos de Judá, em cuja terra derramaram sangue inocente.
verses.en_web: Egypt will be a desolation, and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.en_bbe: Egypt will be a waste and Edom a land of destruction, because of the evil done to the children of Judah, because they have let blood be drained out in their land without cause.

verses.en: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.pt: Mas Judá permanecerá para sempre, e Jerusalém de geração em geração.
verses.en_web: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.en_bbe: But Judah will be peopled for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

verses.en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
verses.pt: E purificarei o sangue que não tinha purificado; e o SENHOR habitará em Sião.
verses.en_web: I will cleanse their blood, that I have not cleansed: for Yahweh dwells in Zion.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will send punishment for their blood, for which punishment has not been sent, for the Lord is living in Zion.
